lines.zh: 四片薄翅一抖，我就窜出去。
lines.en: I flick my four thin wings and dart off.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，偶尔点一下。
lines.en: I skim the water's surface, tapping it now and then.

lines.zh: 河岸的芦苇从我身边掠过。
lines.en: River reeds flick past me.

lines.zh: 我悬停一下，又换了方向。
lines.en: I hover, then switch direction.

lines.zh: 我的复眼把整条河都看在里头。
lines.en: My compound eyes take in the whole river.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的水草上滑过去。
lines.en: I glide over the marsh weeds.
My wings make a line-thin sound.
I bank sharp and carry no momentum.

lines.zh: 我顺着河风，往上飞了一截。
lines.en: I catch the river wind and rise a little.

lines.zh: 我落在草叶尖上歇一口气。
lines.en: I settle on a grass tip to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 水面映出我，又碎成几片。
lines.en: The water mirrors me, then breaks me apart.

lines.zh: 我一整天都在这个词上打转。
lines.en: All day I loop over the same stretch.

lines.zh: 我停在一根苇杆上，一动不动。
lines.en: I perch on a reed stalk, perfectly still.
My wings fold into a thin line.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过我的翅，泛出蓝。
lines.en: Sunlight passes through my wings and turns blue.

lines.zh: 我在等一只倒霉的小虫。
lines.en: I'm waiting for some unlucky bug.
The water glare is too bright; I squint.
I wipe my face with a foreleg.
When the wind stops, so do I.

lines.zh: 我转了转脑袋，扫了一圈。
lines.en: I turn my head and sweep the area.
I hear a frog croak in the mud.
I close my wings slowly, gently.
My body barely moves.
I'm waiting for it to warm up.

lines.zh: 水面的波纹一圈圈散开。
lines.en: Ripples spread out in rings.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地挂在叶下。
lines.en: I hang motionless under a leaf.
Don't swat at me; I hate the gust.
Did you see me in the water?
I'm smaller than your fingernail.
You're blocking the light off the river.
I'm eyeing the net in your hand.
Move, and I'm gone.
I've perched in your shadow.
This river is my ground.
There's water at your feet; mind it.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，只数你眨眼的次数。
lines.en: I don't blink; I only count yours.
You can't see my wings moving.
Don't slap the water with your palm.
A corner of my wing is torn.
I've been swatted into a spin.
I drop into the water and climb out.
The pattern on my wings is disturbed.
I wobble, then steady my hover.
For something my size, that hurts a long while.
I retreat deep into the reeds.

lines.zh: 我有一个翅膀不太敢动。
lines.en: One of my wings I hardly dare use.
I settle onto a leaf slowly.
Do you want to swat again?

lines.zh: 我停在苇尖，看你举着那东西。
lines.en: I perch on a reed tip, watching what you hold up.
I eat small bugs, not grain.

lines.zh: 你把东西举在水上干嘛。
lines.en: Why hold that over the water?
That thing is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我只对会动的东西有兴趣。
lines.en: Only moving things interest me.

lines.zh: 我落在你的手指上又飞走。
lines.en: I land on your finger and fly off.
My mouthparts can't bite into that.
There's better food in the water.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，我就在旁边等。
lines.en: I won't come close; I'll just wait nearby.
Don't wave it; you're spoiling the air.

lines.zh: 你掀起的气流把我推偏了。
lines.en: The draft you make pushes me off course.
I hit your hand and my wing cants.

lines.zh: 别用手挥，我会被扫下去。
lines.en: Don't wave your hand; I'll get knocked down.

lines.zh: 我从你耳边掠过，翅膜在响。
lines.en: I skim past your ear, my wing membrane humming.
You move, and the splash catches me.
I make a half circle over your head.
Your touch flips me once.
The surface is crowded; we bumped.
Your hat blocks the wind.
I land back on the reed.

lines.zh: 另一只蓝色的在河对岸。
lines.en: Another blue one is across the river.
We chase each other up and down.
Its wings are more transparent than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在水面上贴了一下。
lines.en: We touch above the water.
It circles my territory.
We perch side by side on a reed tip.
I chased it half the afternoon.
Its shadow falls onto the water.

lines.zh: 我们转着圈，谁也不落下。
lines.en: We wheel in circles, neither dropping away.
When it grows dark, it's gone.
I can't lift that.

lines.zh: 我用六只脚推，还是推不动。
lines.en: I push with all six legs and it won't budge.
I land on it and test it.
I hug a pebble and fly with it.
A leaf scrap will keep me busy.
I need all four legs to grip it.
Too heavy; I give up.
I fish it out of the water.
I drag it onto a leaf.
What fell in the water, I can't reach.

lines.zh: 一只小飞虫进了我的视野。
lines.en: A little flying bug entered my sight.
My eyes moved first.
I can work out this angle.
I've risen above it.
Wings folded, I accelerate.

lines.zh: 我的复眼锁住那只小飞虫。
lines.en: My compound eyes lock onto the little midge.
I'm sure I can catch it.

lines.zh: 气流从背后推我，正好下手。
lines.en: The air pushes at my back, perfect for a strike.
I'm closing in.
Very close now, one palm's length.
I line up directly behind it.
This strike won't miss.

lines.zh: 它拐进芦苇，我等着它出来。
lines.en: It ducks into the reeds; I wait for it to come out.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一压，就冲了下去。
lines.en: I drop a wing and dive.
I bank with it through the turn.

lines.zh: 它每转一次，我提前半拍。
lines.en: Every time it turns, I'm half a beat ahead.
I've stayed half a beat behind it.
It's fast, but not as quick to turn.
The water gives me its reflection.
I wait for it to slow.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，然后突然动。
lines.en: I hold still, then move all at once.
It's too close to the reeds.

lines.zh: 我把翅声压到几乎听不见。
lines.en: I quiet my wings until they're almost inaudible.
Its path is straight.

lines.zh: 我停在它尾巴正上方一指处。
lines.en: I hover a finger's width above its tail.
My wingtip nearly touches it.
There's a faint sound in the air.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，借它的倒影定位。
lines.en: I hug the water, tracking by its reflection.

lines.zh: 它飞得再慢一点就好了。
lines.en: If only it flew a little slower.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，六只脚一起抓。
lines.en: I dive in and grab with all six legs.
I catch its wing in my jaws.
The hit is light, but exact.
I rush up from below.
One grab and I'm climbing.
It struggles; I don't let go.
I carry the catch to a reed stalk.
My mandibles clamp once.
I made almost no sound.

lines.zh: 咬中后颈，它连挣都没挣。
lines.en: One bite to the nape and it never struggled.

lines.zh: 我用翅尖拨了一下，它就偏了。
lines.en: One nudge from my wingtip and it veers.
All six legs close at once.

lines.zh: 我的下颚一合，翅膀就停了。
lines.en: My mandibles close and its wings stop.
The catch is tiny; one bite is enough.
I appear above the water's surface.
One wingbeat and I'm here.
The light on the river flickers once.
This is my stretch of river.

lines.zh: 我在苇杆上稳住了身子。
lines.en: I steady myself on a reed stalk.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水汽扑在我身上。
lines.en: Marsh vapor settles on me.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片水面飞了一圈。
lines.en: I fly one lap of this water.

lines.zh: 我落下的影子让鱼散开。
lines.en: My shadow scatters the fish.
The sunlight is just right.
I shake my wings and begin patrol.

lines.zh: 河上起了风，正好送我上来。
lines.en: A wind rises off the river and lifts me.
I'm back over the old river.

lines.zh: 翅膀还带着上一场雨的水。
lines.en: My wings still carry water from the last rain.
A reed tip trembles and I settle.
I rise out from under a leaf.
One small dot is added to the water's surface.
The heat of the fire drives me back.
Knocked down, I hit the water.

lines.zh: 我的翅浸了水，飞不起来。
lines.en: My wings are soaked and can't lift me.
The blast shreds my wings.

lines.zh: 有个东西擦过我的身子。
lines.en: Something grazes my body.
A light closes over me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 没有小虫，我飞得越来越慢。
lines.en: With no small bugs, my flight gets slower.

lines.zh: 雷的光刺痛了所有复眼。
lines.en: Lightning's flash stings every one of my eyes.

lines.zh: 这里没有水面，我无处停。
lines.en: No water here, nowhere to land.
